::: {.bs-widget}
::: {.bs-widget-head}
[Try it]{.bs-widget-tag} [Sampling error and sample size]{.bs-widget-title}
:::
[Our population is the weight (kg) of 10,000 men. Take a random sample, compare its mean with the population mean, and watch each sampling error land on the chart below. Small samples scatter widely; large samples hug zero — and when $n$ reaches the whole population, the error disappears.]{.bs-widget-sub}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof sPop = Inputs.radio(["Normal", "Right-skewed"], {value: "Normal", label: "Population"})
viewof sN = Inputs.select([10, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000], {value: 10, label: "Sample size n", format: d => d.toLocaleString()})
viewof sTake = Inputs.button("Take a sample")
viewof sSweep = Inputs.button("Simulate 25 at every size")
viewof sClear = Inputs.button("Clear chart")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sSizes = [10, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000]
sPopData = {
  let seed = 123;
  const rng = () => { seed = (seed + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
  const N = 10000;
  const normal = Float64Array.from({length: N}, () => 80 + 10 * Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - rng())) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * rng()));
  const skewed = Float64Array.from({length: N}, () => { let s = 0; for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) s += -Math.log(1 - rng()); return 30 + 5 * s; });
  const mk = (a, domain) => {
    const mu = d3.mean(a);
    return {values: a, mu, sigma: Math.sqrt(d3.mean(a, x => (x - mu) ** 2)), domain};
  };
  return {"Normal": mk(normal, [40, 120]), "Right-skewed": mk(skewed, [40, 170])};
}
sP = sPopData[sPop]
sDraw = (vals, n) => {
  const a = Array.from(vals);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = i + Math.floor(Math.random() * (a.length - i)); [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]]; }
  return a.slice(0, n);
}
sSample = { sTake; return sDraw(sP.values, sN); }
sMean = d3.mean(sSample)
sErr = sMean - sP.mu
sSE = n => (sP.sigma / Math.sqrt(n)) * Math.sqrt((10000 - n) / (10000 - 1))

mutable sLog = []
mutable sSweepSeen = 0
mutable sClearSeen = 0
sRecord = {
  sSample;
  mutable sLog = [...mutable sLog, {pop: sPop, n: sN, err: sErr, id: Math.random()}];
  return null;
}
sSweepRun = {
  if (sSweep > mutable sSweepSeen) {
    mutable sSweepSeen = sSweep;
    const out = [];
    for (const n of sSizes) for (let k = 0; k < 25; k++) out.push({pop: sPop, n, err: d3.mean(sDraw(sP.values, n)) - sP.mu, id: Math.random()});
    mutable sLog = [...mutable sLog, ...out];
  }
  return null;
}
sClearRun = {
  if (sClear > mutable sClearSeen) { mutable sClearSeen = sClear; mutable sLog = []; }
  return null;
}
sStyle = ({fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", fontSize: "12px", background: "transparent", color: "var(--bs-ink-2)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  title: `This sample: ${sN.toLocaleString()} of 10,000 men`,
  width: Math.max(300, width - 50), height: 220, marginLeft: 8, marginRight: 8, marginBottom: 36, style: sStyle,
  x: {domain: sP.domain, label: "Weight (kg)", labelAnchor: "right"},
  y: {axis: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(sP.values, Plot.binX({y: "proportion"}, {x: d => d, thresholds: d3.range(sP.domain[0], sP.domain[1] + 0.1, (sP.domain[1] - sP.domain[0]) / 40), fill: "var(--bs-ink-3)", fillOpacity: 0.18, inset: 0.5})),
    Plot.rectY(sSample, Plot.binX({y: "proportion"}, {x: d => d, thresholds: d3.range(sP.domain[0], sP.domain[1] + 0.1, (sP.domain[1] - sP.domain[0]) / 40), fill: "var(--bs-part)", fillOpacity: 0.55, inset: 0.5})),
    Plot.ruleX([sP.mu], {stroke: "var(--bs-ink)", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.ruleX([sMean], {stroke: "var(--bs-part)", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text([sP.mu], {x: d => d, frameAnchor: "top", dy: 2, dx: sErr >= 0 ? -6 : 6, textAnchor: sErr >= 0 ? "end" : "start", text: () => "μ", fill: "var(--bs-ink)", fontWeight: 600}),
    Plot.text([sMean], {x: d => d, frameAnchor: "top", dy: 2, dx: sErr >= 0 ? 6 : -6, textAnchor: sErr >= 0 ? "start" : "end", text: () => "x̄", fill: "var(--bs-part)", fontWeight: 600}),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--bs-line)"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="bs-stats">
  <div class="bs-stat"><div class="k">Sample mean x̄</div><div class="v">${sMean.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
  <div class="bs-stat"><div class="k">Population mean μ</div><div class="v">${sP.mu.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
  <div class="bs-stat hl"><div class="k">Sampling error x̄ − μ</div><div class="v">${Math.abs(sErr) < 0.005 ? "0.00" : (sErr > 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(sErr).toFixed(2)}</div></div>
  <div class="bs-stat"><div class="k">Standard error</div><div class="v">${sSE(sN).toFixed(2)}</div></div>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sPts = sLog.filter(d => d.pop === sPop)
sLast = sPts.length ? sPts[sPts.length - 1] : null
sBand = d3.range(0, 201).map(i => { const n = 10 * Math.pow(1000, i / 200); return {n: Math.min(n, 10000), hi: 2 * sSE(Math.min(n, 10000)), lo: -2 * sSE(Math.min(n, 10000))}; })
sYmax = Math.max(2.4 * sSE(10), ...sPts.map(d => Math.abs(d.err) * 1.05))
Plot.plot({
  title: "Sampling error of every sample you've taken",
  width: Math.max(300, width - 50), height: 280, marginLeft: 44, marginBottom: 40, style: sStyle,
  x: {type: "log", domain: [7, 14000], ticks: sSizes, tickFormat: d => d.toLocaleString(), label: "Sample size n (log scale) →"},
  y: {domain: [-sYmax, sYmax], label: "↑ x̄ − μ (kg)", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(sBand, {x: "n", y1: "lo", y2: "hi", fill: "var(--bs-part)", fillOpacity: 0.08}),
    Plot.line(sBand, {x: "n", y: "hi", stroke: "var(--bs-part)", strokeOpacity: 0.5, strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
    Plot.line(sBand, {x: "n", y: "lo", stroke: "var(--bs-part)", strokeOpacity: 0.5, strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--bs-ink)", strokeWidth: 1}),
    Plot.dot(sPts, {x: d => d.n * Math.exp((((d.id * 9973) % 1) - 0.5) * 0.25), y: "err", r: 3, fill: "var(--bs-part)", fillOpacity: 0.45}),
    Plot.dot(sLast ? [sLast] : [], {x: "n", y: "err", r: 7, stroke: "var(--bs-ink)", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.text(["shaded band: ±2 standard errors"], {frameAnchor: "top-right", dy: 4, dx: -4, fill: "var(--bs-ink-3)", fontSize: 11})
  ]
})
```
